findings.evidence: `rg` finds `exteriorPowerZeroEquiv_toLinearEquiv` and `exteriorPowerOneEquiv_toLinearEquiv` in `TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/ExteriorPower.lean:84,97`, while the new equivalences have no corresponding declarations; only the later bundled GL isomorphism gets `extPowerFDRepDetIso_hom_hom` at line 132.
findings.fix: Add `[simp]` `*_toLinearEquiv` lemmas for both definitions (and optionally derived `*_apply_ιMulti` lemmas), analogous to the existing degree-zero/one exterior-power equivalence API.
findings.issue: `topExtPowerEquivDet` (ExteriorPower.lean:81) and `topExtPowerSLEquivTrivial` (Volume.lean:76) are opaque but have no theorem identifying `.toLinearEquiv` with `exteriorPower.topEquiv`; thus even their action on `ιMulti` is unavailable through the public API.

summary: The two new opaque representation equivalences lack characteristic lemmas exposing their underlying linear equivalences, so consumers cannot compute with the advertised determinant maps without unfolding definitions.
